answers.core: As an abstraction, it's meant to be built upon by other add-ons. More specifically, it allows an entire range of add-ons to exist that otherwise couldn't in the first place. It's not an asset intrinsically
answers.workaround: In GDScript it'd be impossible to replicate. In a module/GDExtension, it would be a fairly hefty amount of boilerplating and bringing in standard/non-native assets in an environment that would ideally not have them in the first place
